evidence: scripts/test_shiki_governance_evidence.sh adds adversarial governance evidence regression coverage for groups A-H.
Group A blocks forged Guardian evidence including label-only approval, negative text, stale head comments, wrong actors, Review Bridge-only approval, and advisory Claude review.
Group B blocks forged CCA verdict and CCA evidence manifest metadata, digest, PR, head, task, repository, artifact, and missing-file cases.
Group C validates evidence_refs and ledger_integrity and blocks mismatched ledger filename, unlisted ledger, unscoped ledger, malformed refs, and digest tampering.
Group D blocks stale mirror state for expected PR, branch, head SHA, required check head, and task status.
Group E blocks PR-authored workflow-runtime-evidence, cache, local-only, and unknown .shiki state mutations.
Group F blocks missing CCA, empty acceptance evidence, missing ledger evidence, missing required checks, and missing required review.
Group G requires exact Guardian approval marker and current live label evidence.
Group H checks workflow/static wiring for Guardian evidence, CCA evidence manifest, Review Bridge, MergeGate, and installer staging.
scripts/validate_shiki.py now requires the governance evidence regression suite, installer template inclusion, and docs markers.
docs/agents/evidence-integrity.md and docs/agents/guardian-policy.md document the adversarial evidence test boundary.

Non-goals preserved: no new Guardian policy semantics, no CCA Review Bridge behavior changes, no branch protection or CODEOWNERS changes, no state class model changes, no CCA evidence manifest redesign, no external signing/GitHub App/reviewer bot, no runtime/provider/migration/Node/P2 work.
summary: Implemented forged, stale, and missing governance evidence regression coverage for T-0049.
